messages:
diana-r: Hi payroll — quick question about a retro bonus on my 2026-08-15 check. I moved from MA -> IL on 2026-06-20 and the bonus was for FY work Jan-Jul. My check shows MA withholding on the bonus in August. Should that have been prorated or taxed to IL for the post-move period?

jen-people-ops: @diana-r thanks for flagging. @samir-payroll can you advise? Also ccd @alex-mgr for manager attestation on dates.

samir-payroll: Hey we'll need to see the bonus earnings ledger and the bonus pay period breakdown. Generally: bonuses are taxable in the state where the services were performed during the period the bonus covers; if bonus covers Jan-Jul, MA-source may apply for pre-move days and IL for post-move days. But bonuses are often paid on a single date which complicates withholding.

diana-r: Bonus memo says "performance period Jan 1 - Jul 31" and pay date 2026-08-15. I was MA until 6/20 and IL after. Emp ID 55890, last4 SSN 4477. Attached relocation form to ticket.

payroll-bot: Created ticket PR-2026-991: "Retro bonus state sourcing (MA->IL) - Diana R (55890)" assigned to samir-payroll.

samir-payroll: Thanks. Two common approaches: 1) allocate bonus by workdate proportion (split MA vs IL based on days in period) and adjust withholding accordingly; or 2) withhold based on pay date location (what was done here). Option 1 is more accurate for state sourcing but requires manual allocation. We'll pull the ledger and compute recommended split.

tax-counsel: Note: MA and IL have different withholding rates and tax treatment of supplemental wages. If the company withheld using supplemental wage flat rate for MA, reallocation may result in over/under withholding and might necessitate a W-2c if amounts reported in boxes 15-17 or state withheld fields are incorrect. We'll review treaty/exemption if any apply.

alex-mgr: I confirm Diana was onsite in MA through 2026-06-20 and then IL remote after that. Manager attestation added to the ticket.

diana-r: Timeline? My CPA asked whether this will change my state filings.

samir-payroll: We'll aim to post the allocation calc in 5 business days. If we reallocate and it changes state withholding reported, payroll will propose either an in-run correction (refund or additional withholding) or issue documentation for you to claim credits on state returns. If we determine the W-2 needs updating, we'll coordinate a W-2c.

diana-r: If you do the allocation, can you show the math so I can give it to my CPA?

samir-payroll: Yes we'll include a line-item calc showing days allocated, gross split, tax withheld per state, and suggested next steps. Example illustration (not final):

```
Performance period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-07-31 = 212 days
MA days (1/1-6/20): 171 days => 171/212 = 80.7% => MA wages XX
IL days (6/21-7/31): 41 days => 19.3% => IL wages YY
```

jen-people-ops: Action items: Diana - confirm relocation doc uploaded (done); Samir - run allocation & post numbers; Tax counsel - confirm if W-2c likely. I'll follow up EOW. :white_check_mark:

diana-r: Doc uploaded. Thanks all.

samir-payroll: Pulling ledger now. Will update ticket with numbers and next-step recommendation.
